story.fullStory:
Kenny Loggins's "Footloose" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Footloose" is a song co-written and recorded by American singer-songwriter Kenny Loggins.

It was released in January 1984 as the first of two singles by Loggins from the 1984 film of the same name (the other one being "I'm Free (Heaven Helps the Man)").

The song spent three weeks at number one, March 31—April 14, 1984, on the US Billboard Hot 100, becoming Loggins' only chart-topper, and was the first of two number-one hits from the film.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 23 weeks on the chart.
